title: Pretty good, not great
text: Pretty good, not great. For my Yeti, these straws could be a TINY bit wider. That way so many seeds wouldn't get stuck in there all the time (I love lemon water and I try so hard to not get seeds in there but fail often). There is no metal taste and they do keep the water SUPER cold as you drink it, but it's just too narrow for me. Also, its SO loud when you take a sip or move the cup at all. This is with any stainless steel straw, but I didn't think it would be this loud. Oh well, better than plastic, I guess.
